FN-MSQTF11-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 126
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Economic Development
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 126 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Private
Investigation Board until October 1, 2028, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions
of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
